description: This file defines a static class 'FluidTagHelper' that provides methods for rendering Liquid tag helpers within OrchardCore, including handling arguments, statements, and processing tag helper output.

methods.name: WriteArgumentsTagHelperAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes arguments using a tag helper, delegating to WriteToAsync.

methods.name: WriteArgumentsBlockHelperAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes arguments and statements as a block, delegating to WriteToAsync.

methods.name: WriteToAsync
methods.description: Core method that processes arguments, statements, and renders the tag helper output asynchronously.
